items.source_en:
Before I retired, I was a judge. Administering justice across the settled systems. But some convict who couldn't pronounce his own name said I was "The Minister" and unfortunately, the name stuck.

Then again, I suppose a man of the cloth is an avatar for the great judge, the one whose verdict is absolute. I believe if given the chance to hear the pleas of these bounty hunters, the ones responsible for my dear Alessandra's death, that he would show no mercy. And neither will I.

Watching them turn on each other in the name of greed and avarice, is more powerful than any eyewitness, or any confession made on the stand. And when the Bounty Hunter's Guild eats itself from the inside out, I will lay here smiling, holding the receipt.
items.legacy_ko:
은퇴하기 전, 나는 판사였다. 정착지 전역에 정의를 집행했지. 하지만 자기 이름도 제대로 발음 못 하는 어떤 죄수가 나를 '장관'이라고 불렀고, 불행히도 그 이름이 굳어버렸다.

생각해 보면, 성직자란 절대적인 판결을 내리는 위대한 재판관의 대리인 같은 존재겠지. 내 사랑하는 알레산드라를 죽게 만든 현상금 사냥꾼들의 탄원을 들을 기회가 주어진다면, 그 재판관은 자비를 베풀지 않을 것이다. 그리고 나 또한 마찬가지다.

탐욕과 욕심 때문에 서로를 배신하는 꼴을 지켜보는 것은 그 어떤 목격자나 법정에서의 자백보다 더 강력한 증거가 된다. 현상금 사냥꾼 길드가 내부에서부터 스스로 무너져 내릴 때, 나는 영수증을 쥔 채 이곳에 누워 미소 지을 것이다.

Happy birthday, Logan! 

Sorry I couldn't make it this year. Such is the nature of the job, but I'll be with you in spirit and all that other crap. I really hope you have a great birthday and get to celebrate a lot with mom and dad. 

Look, I really want you all to know that I'm doing fine. This is where I'm meant to be, and I'm happy. Cydonia isn't as rough as you've heard -- in fact, it's pretty boring! So, I'm not in any danger, okay? No use worrying about me on your birthday.

I'll write again soon. Tell mom and dad I said hey. 

Love ya,  
Chris
